name: home-featured-dishes-time-slot
title: Keep homepage featured dishes scoped to the current meal period
description: Verify and lock the existing homepage flow so featured dishes are returned only from active menus for the requested time slot.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The runtime flow already passes timeSlot from Home to topMenuItems and filters MenuItem by active Menu ids. Added a focused resolver regression test; no duplicate runtime filter was introduced. No local test or build was run because a runnable checkout was unavailable, and GitHub reported no workflow/status checks for the commit.
